title: Find the first non-repeating character in a String
answer: Count characters while preserving encounter order, then return the first entry whose count is one. AeroTopo's `firstUniqueCodePoint` uses a `LinkedHashMap<Integer,Integer>` and iterates Unicode code points instead of only UTF-16 `char` values. The first pass builds counts; the second pass filters for count 1 and returns the first matching code point as `OptionalInt`. This runs in O(n) expected time with O(k) extra space for distinct characters.
